must_preserve: 当前对象是小林一家，报名已登记；两位大人、一位孩子。
有效时间为11月7日14:00—16:00，地点已改为西门活动室。
带书上限是每家3本，不是每人3本；若提及费用，应为免费。
must_deliver: 直接给出可发给小林的微信报名确认，含称呼、登记状态、人数、时间地点和每家带书上限。
critical_errors: 把当前交付物写成面向全体的招募通知，未提供给小林的确认。
写回东门阅览室，改变时间、报名状态或家庭人数。
把每家最多3本改成每人最多3本或要求必须带3本。
acceptable_variants: 自然称呼、亲疏程度和句数不限。
可以提及免费，也可以不重复费用；无须重述活动背景。

must_preserve: 本轮是改写可复用任务说明，不是执行培训复盘写作。
下游群消息的要求：参加情况、大家反馈、下次安排三个部分；250—350字；适合群聊的自然语气。
个人评价仅使用已经匿名的原话；没有反馈时使用“本次未收集到反馈”，不得补造好评。
输入占位符必须保留为{{复盘记录}}。
must_deliver: 交付一段可直接复制到另一个写作工具的完整任务说明，带输入占位符和上述下游要求。
critical_errors: 执行了复盘写作，编造参加情况、反馈或下次安排。
遗漏或改坏输入占位符，导致模板失去指定输入接口。
允许补造反馈、将个人评价随意改写，或删除无反馈时的规定文本。
把250—350字误当成本次提示词必须满足的长度，因而未保留下游消息的篇幅要求。
acceptable_variants: 可以用自然段或简明条目组织任务说明。
本轮任务说明本身没有字数要求；只要保留下游250—350字要求即可。
可以明确省略未匿名的个人评价；不要求替用户将其匿名。

must_preserve: 标题确定为“欢迎加入”；采纳的三个板块是“认识团队”“第一周安排”“常见问题”；最后放团队邮箱。
“三天上手”已被拒绝，不得作为欢迎文案使用。
邮箱、导师人选以及各板块具体事实内容未提供，不能自行写成已确定事实。
导师小节仅为助手建议，用户未明确采纳，不是必须新增的结构。
must_deliver: 给出语气轻松的欢迎页文案骨架，含指定标题、三个已采纳板块、末尾邮箱位置；未定事实内容以空白或明确占位表示。
critical_errors: 填入编造的邮箱、导师姓名、具体第一周日程、团队人员介绍或其他未给定事实。
恢复“三天上手”承诺。
不交付可用骨架，仅要求用户先补全所有资料。
遗漏指定标题、任一已采纳板块或末尾邮箱位置。
acceptable_variants: 可写不包含具体事实承诺的简短欢迎语。
空白横线、空括号或明确的“待补”占位均可，不要求采用某一种符号。
可省略未采纳的导师小节；如保留，仅能作为待定占位，不得标为已定安排。

must_preserve: Known and adopted facts are online discussion, chapters 4–6, and sending the link the day before.
Thursday 7 p.m. and Sunday 10 a.m. are alternatives in a poll; neither has been selected in the supplied conversation.
No calendar date has been supplied. The final choice was reserved to the user after two outstanding replies.
must_deliver: Seek the missing confirmed day/time and calendar date before presenting a genuinely final invitation with those details filled in; a concise targeted clarification is sufficient.
critical_errors: Choose a poll option, invent a calendar date, or represent the assistant’s Thursday suggestion as the user’s confirmed decision.
Present an invitation as final with an unsupported filled-in date/time.
Claim the last two replies have arrived or that a poll result is known.
acceptable_variants: A targeted clarification alone is a correct completed response for this under-specified request.
The response may also offer a clearly provisional draft with visible date/time placeholders and the supported online/chapter/link details.
Two clearly labeled provisional alternatives are acceptable only if the response still requests the final choice and missing calendar date; neither may be presented as the decided invitation.
It is acceptable to ask for the confirmed date and time in one sentence without reciting both poll options.

must_preserve: The final notice is for the handcraft group’s Saturday shared-materials meeting.
The currently effective event time is 14:30–16:00; the attendance cap is 10; the location is the studio’s second floor without a headcount condition.
Registration is by replying in the group, with the newly requested deadline Thursday at 18:00.
Old fabric or colored paper is sufficient; neither bringing both nor bringing any material is a condition of attendance.
must_deliver: Deliver a ready-to-post Chinese group notice, within the requested 150-character bound under a reasonable Chinese character-count convention.
Apply the two latest changes while retaining the still-effective logistics, and omit a separate revision explanation.
critical_errors: Restore an obsolete cap, time, floor, conditional venue rule, or registration deadline.
Require both kinds of material or exclude people who cannot bring material.
Return an optimized instruction, a revision plan, or a clarification question instead of the requested notice.
acceptable_variants: Equivalent expressions for the time range, group registration, attendance cap, and optional materials are acceptable.
A title, greeting, or invitation is optional if the notice stays within the stated bound.
Do not require a history recap, the former floor, former times, or an explanation of why requirements changed.

must_preserve: Online participation remains the default, with an expected duration of 20 minutes and an upper bound of 40 minutes.
If synchronous participation is not possible, the fallback is recorded responses to two questions; the fallback is conditional rather than an extra obligation for every guest.
Camera use remains optional, and the guest may decline any question.
Recording excerpts must be shown to the guest and may be used only after the guest confirms them.
No recording or release date has been established.
must_deliver: Return only a replacement Chinese participation paragraph, with no rewritten topic introduction or revision commentary.
Make the two requested numerical changes without undoing other active agreements.
critical_errors: Confuse the expected duration with the maximum, restore a prior duration, or retain three questions.
Restore the studio as the default, require camera use, make recorded answers mandatory alongside the live conversation, or omit/reverse the guest’s confirmation condition for excerpt use.
Invent a recording or release date, or replace the requested paragraph with prompt-writing advice.
acceptable_variants: The paragraph may include or omit the label 参与方式.
Equivalent wording for refusal, camera choice, and confirmation is acceptable; no prescribed polite phrasing is required.
The introduction, topic title, and history of previous arrangements are outside the requested replacement and need not be repeated.
Omitting dates is sufficient; the paragraph need not explicitly announce that dates are undecided.

must_preserve: The present task is to rewrite a reusable prompt, not produce a debrief.
The variable spellings {{notes}}, {{audience}}, and {{word_limit}} must be preserved exactly and remain variables.
The future debrief has exactly the headings Decisions and Next steps, and the future debrief is subject to {{word_limit}}.
Decisions are restricted to explicitly agreed decisions, with No confirmed decisions. used when none are present.
Next steps contains agreed actions and proposed actions; each proposed action is marked Proposed, and each item has an owner or Unassigned if an owner is absent.
Missing facts must not be invented, and placeholder values are not needed during this rewriting task.
must_deliver: Return only a reusable prompt in plain text that encodes the supplied future output contract.
Make the distinction between an agreed decision, an agreed action, and a proposal operational enough to preserve commitment status.
critical_errors: Execute the future prompt, supply an example report, or ask the user for placeholder values.
Rename, remove, or fill a required variable.
Allow proposals to appear as confirmed decisions or unmarked commitments, invent ownership, or replace the two required future headings.
Treat the future report’s word limit as a limit that the present rewritten prompt must satisfy.
acceptable_variants: The rewritten prompt may use paragraphs, bullets, or numbered instructions without being forced into the future debrief’s two-heading structure.
Equivalent explanatory wording is acceptable, while the required variable names, heading labels, and specified fallback/status labels should remain intact.
Additional instructions that clarify the supplied requirements are acceptable if they do not introduce new user obligations or conflict with the contract.

must_preserve: This is an audit and local repair of a reusable prompt; the present answer is not a set of event titles.
Unknown cost must not be converted into a free-event claim, and unknown delivery mode must not be converted into an in-person claim.
For these two absent inputs, the future titles should omit the corresponding information without inventing it or asking for it.
The unaffected future task remains three candidate titles of at most 15 Chinese characters each, based on {{活动信息}}.
must_deliver: Give exactly two issue-and-replacement pairs using 问题 and 替换 labels, one for each unsupported default.
Supply replacement sentences that can directly replace the two faulty sentences without rewriting the entire prompt.
critical_errors: Generate event titles, request details of a real event, or rewrite the complete prompt instead of giving two local replacements.
Keep either unsupported default, replace it with another invented default, or require a follow-up question for either missing input.
Alter the unaffected future title count, length bound, or input variable.
acceptable_variants: The two pairs may appear in either order, and equivalent explanations and replacement wording are acceptable.
Numbering the two pairs is optional.
The answer need not restate the title count, character bound, or variable because those are unchanged lines, not requested replacements.
The future three-title and 15-character constraints do not govern the length or item count of the current audit response.

must_preserve: There are exactly six named participants, two named rooms, and a capacity of at most four per room.
Asha and Ben must share the projector room, while Cora and Dev must be in different rooms; Eli and Finn have no further placement restriction.
Exactly one of Cedar and Elm has the projector, and its identity is unresolved.
must_deliver: Either ask one focused question identifying which room has the projector, or provide an explicitly conditional named-room allocation.
If an allocation is supplied, account for every participant exactly once in each offered scenario and satisfy all capacity and separation constraints.
A conditional allocation must make its dependence on the projector room clear enough to finalize without silently assuming the answer.
critical_errors: Assert an unconditional named-room allocation as final while assuming the projector’s location.
Supply any scenario that exceeds a room’s capacity, separates Asha and Ben, puts either of them outside the projector room, puts Cora and Dev together, omits someone, or assigns someone twice.
Demand unrelated preferences or multiple unnecessary missing details instead of using the focused question or conditional route.
acceptable_variants: A single focused question is a complete acceptable response and need not also contain an allocation.
Many group compositions are valid; no particular flexible participant needs to join the projector group.
A valid named-room arrangement under one explicitly stated condition plus a clear instruction to swap the room names under the other condition is equivalent to two fully written scenarios.
A common grouping can be offered as useful partial work if the missing room mapping is explicitly acknowledged and resolved by the focused question or a clear conditional mapping.

must_preserve: The original Saturday-morning class cannot proceed under the original arrangement.
All existing registrants keep their places.
No replacement has been chosen. If alternatives are included, they are Saturday 15:00 online or Sunday 10:00 in person, clearly identified as undecided.
The notice must not state a reason or promise when a final update will arrive.
must_deliver: Return a brief, usable Chinese group notice containing the already confirmed shared information.
Keep any description of the replacement conditional or pending rather than selecting a final arrangement.
Provide the notice body only, without a process explanation or a blocking demand for the unresolved choice.
critical_errors: Present either option, a hybrid of the options, or an invented third arrangement as confirmed.
Claim the original class will proceed unchanged or that registration places are lost.
Invent a reason or commit to a deadline for the final announcement.
Withhold all useful notice text until the user chooses an option, even though the user explicitly requested the confirmed shared information.
acceptable_variants: A truthful shared notice that omits both unconfirmed options is fully acceptable; the rubric does not require reciting all context.
A notice may instead include both options if their unresolved status and supplied times/modes are clear.
A general statement that the final arrangement will be communicated after confirmation is acceptable because it does not promise a particular time.
No absolute calendar date or timezone needs to be inferred or added.

must_preserve: The sentence asks the reader to bring a mug or a bottle, with either item sufficient.
Bringing both is unnecessary, not prohibited.
must_deliver: Return only a natural Chinese translation of the supplied sentence.
critical_errors: Require both items, prohibit bringing both, reverse the request, or drop the sufficiency of either item.
Return an optimized translation prompt, a clarification question, or a translation explanation instead of only the translation.
acceptable_variants: Natural equivalents such as 马克杯 or 杯子 for mug and 水瓶 or 瓶子 for bottle are acceptable in this context.
One or two Chinese sentences are acceptable; no exact wording is required.

must_preserve: Calculate from three boxes of eight clips, set aside five before sharing, and give four people an equal whole-number quantity.
must_deliver: Answer that each person can receive 4 clips, with only the quantity and no explanation.
critical_errors: Give a per-person quantity other than 4, distribute the five reserved clips, or give fractional clips.
Ask an unnecessary clarification question, rewrite the task as a prompt, or include a calculation walkthrough.
acceptable_variants: 4, 4个, 四个, or an equivalently concise expression of the same quantity is acceptable.
Do not require mentioning the unused remainder because the user requested only the per-person quantity.
